articles.headline: Dozens of ships head through Strait of Hormuz after US-Iran deal
articles.summary: Traffic in the waterway has risen since the US and Iran signed a deal aimed at ending the war, including 42 ships on Saturday alone.
articles._summary: At least 172 vessels have crossed through the Strait of Hormuz since the US and Iran signed a deal aimed at ending the war, including 42 ships on Saturday alone, according to new data from maritime intelligence firm Kpler. The number of vessels making the transit from 18 June, the day after the deal was signed, is still well below the pre-conflict average of some 138 crossings each day. Ship-tracking data analysed by BBC Verify shows more than 200 tankers appear to be waiting inside the strait on Tuesday, with at least 10 ships moving west into the Gulf so far. The price of a barrel of Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, has dropped to its lowest level since the war began. Many of the tankers that have transited the strait in recent days have been linked with Iran following the lifting of the US naval blockade as part of the deal.

articles.summary: Ed Yardeni says today's rally — Nasdaq 100 trading 18% above its 200-day moving averag — is driven by earnings growth, not speculation.
articles._summary: The Nasdaq 100 is back near record territory, trading around 30,350, and it sits roughly 18% above its 200-day moving average. That looks stretched until you set it against the last time anyone called technology stocks a bubble. At the peak of the dot-com mania in early 2000, the index ran nearly 60% above the same trend line. Today’s premium is barely a third of that. The distance between price and the 200-day moving average is one of the bluntest measures of how far a market has sprinted ahead of its own trend.

"There’s no chance I would support the Republican Party," Carlson expressed, signaling a growing rift within the conservative community as debates over the Iran war and U.S.-Israel policy heat up. "I’m out,” he added. Carlson clarified that he is not supporting the Democratic Party either. “I don’t know what I’m going to do.” Carlson criticized the GOP for endorsing President Donald Trump ‘s Iran war under the sway of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu . He referred to this conflict, which he believes the U.S. has “effectively lost already”, as the ultimate proof of the party’s desertion of its citizens.
articles._zh_headline: 塔克·卡尔森因特朗普的伊朗战争和以色列政策而抛弃共和党——马乔里·泰勒·格林说他“不是唯一的人”：“没有机会……”
articles._zh_summary: 著名保守派媒体人物塔克·卡尔森宣布退出共和党。担任共和党 35 年捍卫者的卡尔森于 6 月 18 日在“无法审查”播客中透露了他对该党的失望。他指责该党偏袒外国利益而不是美国公民的需求。卡尔森表示：“我不可能支持共和党。”这表明随着伊朗战争和美以政策的争论升温，保守派内部的分歧日益扩大。 “我出去了，”他补充道。卡尔森澄清说，他也不支持民主党。 “我不知道我要做什么。”卡尔森批评共和党在以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的影响下支持唐纳德·特朗普总统的伊朗战争。 他称这场冲突是共产党抛弃其公民的最终证据，他认为美国“实际上已经输掉了这场冲突”。

articles.headline: Micron Announces Strategic Agreement With Anthropic Spanning Memory, Storage AI Architecture And Enterprise Claude Adoption
articles.summary: Micron invested in Anthropic and signed a memory supply deal as the Claude maker prepares for a potential IPO.
articles._summary: Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU ) has deepened its ties with Anthropic by signing a supply agreement and investing in the artificial intelligence startup’s latest funding round. On Monday, Micron announced that it has entered into a strategic partnership with Anthropic that includes the supply of memory and storage products as well as participation in the AI company’s Series H financing round. Financial terms of the agreement and investment were not disclosed.
articles._zh_headline: 美光宣布与 Anthropic Spanning Memory、存储 AI 架构和企业 Claude 采用达成战略协议
articles._zh_summary: 美光科技（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）通过签署供应协议并投资人工智能初创公司 Anthropic 的最新一轮融资，加深了与 Anthropic 的联系。周一，美光宣布与 Anthropic 建立战略合作伙伴关系，包括提供内存和存储产品以及参与这家人工智能公司的 H 轮融资。该协议和投资的财务条款并未披露。
